label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Make Your Emails Easy to Read on Any Device
body: Most people check emails on their phones, so ensure your layout looks good on small screens.
caption:
When crafting your emails, imagine someone quickly scrolling through on their phone. Is the text clear? Are buttons easy to tap? Keeping your emails simple and optimized for mobile means more people will actually read your messages. It’s a small tweak that can make a big difference in how your audience connects with you. Take a moment to preview your next email on a mobile device!
